content:
The legal profession comes with its own language of abbreviations and procedural terms. Understanding these terms makes court proceedings, drafting, case reading and legal communication easier and more precise.

I'm sharing this quick reference guide for law students, interns, young advocates and anyone interested in understanding legal practice.
- Adv. Preeti Singh Yadav

Patna High Court
